scope: Controlled native IPC, game activity hook and two renderer integration; partial P11 verification
result: PASS: a registered owned generic Windows process was detected through the real filtered CIM service; activity propagated through real authenticated HTTP/WebSocket services to a second synthetic account. Per-game sharing revocation and account-wide opt-out each removed it from the other renderer. A foreign renderer was denied privileged IPC and observed activity payloads did not expose executable paths.
qualification: Production IPC callback and trusted-frame source slices were used with a controlled harness, not the full central registrar, file picker or complete HiChat UI. The process was not a game; no Steam or CS2 was launched. Actual game, installed-app and physical two-client acceptance remain open.
cleanup: Owned process, test windows and isolated container were removed.
